reason: The analyst reports a single unadjusted regression (2.29, trimmed on the outcome) with no pre-period controls. My own analysis shows that adjusting for lagged productivity and the other 2020 covariates cuts the estimate to about 0.84, so the reported effect is roughly 2.7 times too large because of selection. The trimming on the outcome and the single specification are also unjustified, so the conclusion is not supported as stated.
